scope.interpretation_summary: The Packaging Testing Market encompasses services and solutions that ensure packaging materials and products meet regulatory standards and performance requirements. Participants include testing laboratories, equipment ma
scope.market_definition: The Packaging Testing Market encompasses services and solutions that ensure packaging materials and products meet regulatory standards and performance requirements. Participants include testing laboratories, equipment manufacturers, and various channel partners such as distributors and converters, operating globally across diverse packaging sectors.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer includes laboratories and organizations that perform various tests on packaging materials to ensure compliance and performance.
This layer includes various partners that distribute and resell testing services and equipment.

[Chemical Testing]

## [Chemical Testing][86]

There are different types of chemical testing and standards based on your specific product and
destination market. Having your products tested in a chemical testing laboratory will ensure product
compliance.

[Learn More][87]
[Pre-Shipment Inspection]

## [Pre-Shipment Inspection][88]

When 80% of your order is complete, an inspector visits the factory and uses industry standard
processes to comprehensively review and test your product, ensuring it meets agreed upon
specifications.

[Learn More][89]
[PEO Inspections for Mexico]

## [PEO Inspections for Mexico][90]

Streamline shipments to Mexico with our import scheme: review container details at origin for
customs clearance in under 48 hours. Save time and costs by addressing issues upfront for importers,
agents, and forwarders.

[Learn More][91]
[Food Certification]

## [Food Certification][92]

Achieving certification under one or several internationally recognized schemes helps you improve
and harmonize food safety standards in your supply chain, streamlines your access to global markets,
and sends a message of quality to your consumers.

[Learn More][93]
[Pre-clinical Research and Testing]

## [Pre-clinical Research and Testing][94]

We cover pre-clinical product development, from creating new models and assays to conducting in
vitro and ex vivo testing. We also conduct thorough studies on pharmaceutical, cosmeceutical and
nutraceutical compounds, and their respective formulations.

[Learn More][95]
[Cybersecurity]

## [Cybersecurity][96]

We offer cybersecurity evaluations and consultations to ensure products are secured against
cyber-attacks and result in no privacy violations, financial fraud, identity theft or harm to
well-being. We also ensure personal safety of IoT device users.

[Learn More][97]

visibility and intelligence to your operations.

### Every day, our technology makes a** safer**,
### **sustainable **and more **productive ** world a reality.

**We do it by bringing together and investing in passionate, talented people.**

##### **As a leading global provider **of differentiated electronic instruments and
##### electromechanical devices, we are proud to solve some of the world’s most complex challenges.
##### Our strength comes from **four key areas**.

#### OUR NICHE MARKET FOCUS

### A combined vision for success

We target niche markets aligned with secular growth trends that provide multiple avenues of growth.

#### OUR GROWTH MODEL

### Designed to excel

The AMETEK Growth Model integrates Operational Excellence, New Product Development, Global and
Market Expansion, and Strategic Acquisitions with a focus on cash flow generation and disciplined
capital deployment.

#### OUR PEOPLE AND CULTURE

### United by bright prospects

We have a strong performance-driven and decentralized culture made of diverse high-performance teams
located across the globe that execute our strategy and embrace our values by doing the right thing
every day, in every interaction.

#### OUR PERFORMANCE

### Proud to be out in front

Our culture is to outperform. Over the past 15, 10, and 5-year periods we have substantially
outperformed the S&P 500 index and the S&P Industrials. We deliver double-digit earnings over the
business cycle.

### **Explore** our products

##### **Life is full of complex challenges****.** Each one inspires us to do what we love. To make
##### the world a better place. Not just with our differentiated technologies that improve countless
##### lives, but by **empowering our people to inspire others** across the globe.

AMETEK CONSISTS OF TWO DIFFERENTIATED OPERATING GROUPS

## Our electronic instruments

AMETEK is a worldwide leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced analytical, test and
measurement instrumentation for the energy, aerospace, power, research, medical and industrial
markets.
BOTH OPERATING GROUPS OCCUPY LEADING POSITIONS IN NICHE MARKETS

## Our electromechanical devices

We are world-renowned as a differentiated supplier of automation and precision motion control
solutions, and highly engineered electrical interconnects, specialty metals and thermal management
systems.

There are different types of chemical testing and standards based on your specific product and
destination market. Having your products tested in a chemical testing laboratory will ensure product
compliance.

[Learn More][87]
[Pre-Shipment Inspection]

## [Pre-Shipment Inspection][88]

When 80% of your order is complete, an inspector visits the factory and uses industry standard
processes to comprehensively review and test your product, ensuring it meets agreed upon
specifications.

[Learn More][89]
[PEO Inspections for Mexico]

## [PEO Inspections for Mexico][90]

Streamline shipments to Mexico with our import scheme: review container details at origin for
customs clearance in under 48 hours. Save time and costs by addressing issues upfront for importers,
agents, and forwarders.

[Learn More][91]
[Food Certification]

## [Food Certification][92]

Achieving certification under one or several internationally recognized schemes helps you improve
and harmonize food safety standards in your supply chain, streamlines your access to global markets,
and sends a message of quality to your consumers.

[Learn More][93]
[Pre-clinical Research and Testing]

## [Pre-clinical Research and Testing][94]

We cover pre-clinical product development, from creating new models and assays to conducting in
vitro and ex vivo testing. We also conduct thorough studies on pharmaceutical, cosmeceutical and
nutraceutical compounds, and their respective formulations.

[Learn More][95]
[Cybersecurity]

## [Cybersecurity][96]

We offer cybersecurity evaluations and consultations to ensure products are secured against
cyber-attacks and result in no privacy violations, financial fraud, identity theft or harm to
well-being. We also ensure personal safety of IoT device users.

[Learn More][97]

# ΑΣΤΕΡΙΑΔΗΣ - Εξοπλισμός Εργαστηρίων

Η Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. δραστηριοποιείται:

Στον τομέα του Εξοπλισμού Εργαστηρίων Έρευνας και Ανάπτυξης, Ποιοτικού Ελέγχου, Βιοϊατρικής και
Βιοτεχνολογίας, με πλήρεις λύσεις συμπεριλαμβανομένης της μελέτης και οργάνωσης των εργαστηρίων.

Στον τομέα της Ηλεκτρονικής και Ηλεκτροτεχνικής Βιομηχανίας, με εξοπλισμό για την ανάπτυξη της
παραγωγικής διαδικασίας και πλήρη κάλυψη σε πρώτες ύλες και υλικά.

Υπηρεσίες

## Παρέχουμε προϊόντα και υπηρεσίες υψηλής ποιότητας

που προσαρμόζονται στις ανάγκες των πελατών μας

Εγκαταστάσεις Εκπαιδεύσεις Εφαρμογές Δοκιμές & Διακριβώσεις Service

Ο πελάτης λαμβάνει συμβουλές για τις απαιτήσεις χώρου και περιβάλλοντος, ενώ επίσης εξετάζονται οι
προδιαγραφές για την ηλεκτρική παροχή και τις απαιτήσεις αερίων ή νερού πριν από την εγκατάσταση.

Οποιαδήποτε εγκατάσταση και λειτουργία συσκευής γίνεται σύμφωνα με τις οδηγίες του κατασκευαστή και
μπορεί να απαιτηθεί πλήρως τεκμηριωμένος έλεγχος IQ/OQ αν το επιθυμεί ο πελάτης.

[shutterstock_100411144__1_-removebg-preview][shutterstock_100411144__1_-removebg-preview]

Οι χρήστες του οργάνου εκπαιδεύονται πλήρως από εξειδικευμένο προσωπικό.

**Κάθε εκπαίδευση συνοδεύεται από ένα πιστοποιητικό εκπαίδευσης** στο όνομα του χρήστη,
υπογεγραμμένο από τον εκπαιδευτή.

[shutterstock_245572090-removebg-preview][shutterstock_245572090-removebg-preview]

Πέρα από τη βασική εκπαίδευση για τη χρήση του εξοπλισμού, ο πελάτης μπορεί να επιλέξει να λάβει μια
πλήρως δοκιμασμένη εφαρμογή που αναπτύσσεται από το Τμήμα Εφαρμογών μας.

Αυτή η υπηρεσία στοχεύει στην προσαρμογή στις ανάγκες του πελάτη και στη δημιουργία λειτουργικής
ημερήσιας διαδικασίας, περιλαμβάνοντας βελτιστοποίηση της προετοιμασίας δειγμάτων, ανάπτυξη μεθόδου
επεξεργασίας δειγμάτων, συλλογή δεδομένων, και επαλήθευση αποτελεσμάτων με εργαστήρια τρίτων.

[shutterstock_1538502419-removebg-preview][shutterstock_1538502419-removebg-preview]

Για να εξασφαλίσει την ποιότητα των αποτελεσμάτων, ο πελάτης πρέπει να επιβεβαιώνει περιοδικά ότι το
όργανό του λειτουργεί σύμφωνα με τις προδιαγραφές του κατασκευαστή.

Η Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. διασφαλίζει αυτήν τη διαδικασία μέσω συνεχούς εκπαίδευσης των τεχνικών της στις
εγκαταστάσεις των κατασκευαστών για ελέγχους IQ/OQ/PQ για κάθε προμηθευθέν όργανο.

Επιπλέον, η εταιρεία επενδύει σε σύγχρονο εξοπλισμό δοκιμών, ο οποίος διατηρείται και διακριβώνεται
σε τακτικά διαστήματα από ανεξάρτητα εργαστήρια.

[shutterstock_2278230623-removebg-preview][shutterstock_2278230623-removebg-preview]

Στη Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. η δέσμευσή μας για παροχή υψηλής ποιότητας επιστημονικού και αναλυτικού

## Παρέχουμε προϊόντα και υπηρεσίες υψηλής ποιότητας

που προσαρμόζονται στις ανάγκες των πελατών μας

Εγκαταστάσεις Εκπαιδεύσεις Εφαρμογές Δοκιμές & Διακριβώσεις Service

Ο πελάτης λαμβάνει συμβουλές για τις απαιτήσεις χώρου και περιβάλλοντος, ενώ επίσης εξετάζονται οι
προδιαγραφές για την ηλεκτρική παροχή και τις απαιτήσεις αερίων ή νερού πριν από την εγκατάσταση.

Οποιαδήποτε εγκατάσταση και λειτουργία συσκευής γίνεται σύμφωνα με τις οδηγίες του κατασκευαστή και
μπορεί να απαιτηθεί πλήρως τεκμηριωμένος έλεγχος IQ/OQ αν το επιθυμεί ο πελάτης.

[shutterstock_100411144__1_-removebg-preview][shutterstock_100411144__1_-removebg-preview]

Οι χρήστες του οργάνου εκπαιδεύονται πλήρως από εξειδικευμένο προσωπικό.

**Κάθε εκπαίδευση συνοδεύεται από ένα πιστοποιητικό εκπαίδευσης** στο όνομα του χρήστη,
υπογεγραμμένο από τον εκπαιδευτή.

[shutterstock_245572090-removebg-preview][shutterstock_245572090-removebg-preview]

Πέρα από τη βασική εκπαίδευση για τη χρήση του εξοπλισμού, ο πελάτης μπορεί να επιλέξει να λάβει μια
πλήρως δοκιμασμένη εφαρμογή που αναπτύσσεται από το Τμήμα Εφαρμογών μας.

Αυτή η υπηρεσία στοχεύει στην προσαρμογή στις ανάγκες του πελάτη και στη δημιουργία λειτουργικής
ημερήσιας διαδικασίας, περιλαμβάνοντας βελτιστοποίηση της προετοιμασίας δειγμάτων, ανάπτυξη μεθόδου
επεξεργασίας δειγμάτων, συλλογή δεδομένων, και επαλήθευση αποτελεσμάτων με εργαστήρια τρίτων.

[shutterstock_1538502419-removebg-preview][shutterstock_1538502419-removebg-preview]

Για να εξασφαλίσει την ποιότητα των αποτελεσμάτων, ο πελάτης πρέπει να επιβεβαιώνει περιοδικά ότι το
όργανό του λειτουργεί σύμφωνα με τις προδιαγραφές του κατασκευαστή.

Η Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. διασφαλίζει αυτήν τη διαδικασία μέσω συνεχούς εκπαίδευσης των τεχνικών της στις
εγκαταστάσεις των κατασκευαστών για ελέγχους IQ/OQ/PQ για κάθε προμηθευθέν όργανο.

Επιπλέον, η εταιρεία επενδύει σε σύγχρονο εξοπλισμό δοκιμών, ο οποίος διατηρείται και διακριβώνεται
σε τακτικά διαστήματα από ανεξάρτητα εργαστήρια.

## Σχετικά με Εμάς

Η ιστορία της Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. ξεκινά το 1955, όταν ο Νικόλαος Αστεριάδης ιδρύει την τότε
«ΝΙΚΟΛΑΟΣ ΑΣΤΕΡΙΑΔΗΣ» στη Θεσσαλονίκη – μια μικρή επιχείρηση με μεγάλο όραμα: να φέρει στην Ελλάδα
την τεχνολογική πρόοδο μέσα από την επιστημονική και βιομηχανική καινοτομία. Ένα όραμα που
εξελίχθηκε, επεκτάθηκε και σταθεροποιήθηκε το 1985 με τη σύσταση της σημερινής εταιρικής μορφής. 

Αρχικά δραστηριοποιούμενη ως αντιπρόσωπος εταιρειών επιστημονικών οργάνων της Αθήνας στη Βόρεια
Ελλάδα, η εταιρεία δεν άργησε να χαράξει τη δική της αυτόνομη πορεία. Σημαντικοί σταθμοί ήταν η
συνεργασία με την Eppendorf, καθώς και η αποκλειστική διάθεση των μικροσκοπίων ZEISS στη Βόρεια
Ελλάδα. Από τα μέσα της δεκαετίας του ’60, διευρύνει τις δραστηριότητές της στον τομέα του
επαγγελματικού ήχου και της εμπορίας ηλεκτρονικών εξαρτημάτων, ενώ το 1967 αποκτά παρουσία και στην
Αθήνα με νέο υποκατάστημα. 

Το 1973, η συνεργασία με τη JEOL καθιστά την εταιρεία πρωτοπόρο στον τομέα της Ηλεκτρονικής
Μικροσκοπίας, ενώ η στρατηγική συμμαχία με τη SHIMADZU το 1978 δίνει νέα ώθηση στην αγορά των
Αναλυτικών Οργάνων.

### CAA is the **Producer Responsibility Organization** for
### **paper and packaging** in the United States

As a nonprofit, producer-led organization, CAA is committed to delivering harmonized, best-in-class
compliance services to all producers to advance an efficient and effective circular economy.

[**California**][92]**
**Approved in January 2024 to implement the Plastic Pollution Prevention and Packaging Producer
Responsibility Act.

[**Colorado**][93]**
**Approved in May 2023 to implement the Producer Responsibility Program for Statewide Recycling Act

[**Minnesota**][94]
On Feb. 18, 2025, the Minnesota Pollution Control Agency confirmed CAA’s registration to implement
the state’s EPR program. Producers must be a member of a PRO that is registered with MPCA by July 1,
2025. 

[**Maryland**][95]
Selected in October 2023 to represent producer interests and serve as the single PRO on the State
Producer Responsibility Advisory Council.

[**Maine**][96]
CAA intends to respond to Maine’s RFP to serve as it’s Stewardship Organization (SO).

[**Oregon**][97]
CAA is the PRO in Oregon. On April 1, 2024. CAA was the only prospective PRO to submit a program
plan to DEQ.

[**Washington**][98]
On March 4, 2026, Washington Department of Ecology (Ecology) announced CAA as the PRO.

[**Maryland**][95]
Selected in October 2023 to represent producer interests and serve as the single PRO on the State
Producer Responsibility Advisory Council.

[**Maine**][96]
CAA intends to respond to Maine’s RFP to serve as it’s Stewardship Organization (SO).

[**Oregon**][97]
CAA is the PRO in Oregon. On April 1, 2024. CAA was the only prospective PRO to submit a program
plan to DEQ.

[**Washington**][98]
On March 4, 2026, Washington Department of Ecology (Ecology) announced CAA as the PRO.

Testing Laboratory

## 100% Focused on Packaging

Through both routine and project-based assessments, our ISO 17025 accredited laboratory was built to
serve the needs of the global packaging industry.

[Learn How We Test][13]

Advanced Analytics

## Transform Your Data into Insights

We digitize your packaging testing data to automatically derive cost reduction and quality
improvement opportunities that will resonate at all levels within your organization.

[See The Power of Data][14]

## Who We Are

We are a Packaging Testing Laboratory with 12+ years of experience and commitment to excellence for
our clients and the packaging industry!

Our focus is on enhancing packaging solutions by collaborating with brands, packaging converters,
and raw material suppliers. Through these partnerships, we aim to improve product quality, reduce
costs, support sustainability efforts, and elevate the overall experience for end users.

We are equipped with both a Client Services Team and a Project Team to ensure your success.  We do
this by meeting with clients on a regular schedule, interpreting testing data, proposing corrective
actions, sharing industry best practices on test methods and sustainability initiatives, maintaining
specs on products, and providing facility audits and consulting as needed.

 


## Visualize Your Data

Interested in interacting with our ClearVUE data visualization platform? Click the link below to see
how we transform testing data into valuable insights, while uniting the packaging supply chain, one
test at a time.

[Interactive Demo][15]

## How We Help

Routine Product Testing

Ensure specification compliance, reduce waste, and proactively identify cost and quality improvement
opportunities through ongoing, scheduled assessments of both raw materials and finished products.

Project Based Testing

Whether it’s new product or supplier qualification, performance benchmarking, root cause analysis,
or competitive comparisons, our Projects Team will design a testing scheme for your exact
requirements.

In-Field Defect Audits

We quantify true in-field defect rates by collecting product samples directly from distribution
centers or retail locations, and then test each and every product in our laboratory to reveal the
true quality of what you’re buying.

Sustainability Analysis

Through a comprehensive set of testing, software, and consulting offerings, we can provide
sustainability measures, tools and services for every stage of a packaging product’s lifecycle.

Specification Development

By analyzing existing performance data, testing key attributes, and leveraging our established
industry relationships, we provide expert services to develop, update, or standardize packaging
specifications.

Facility Auditing & Environmental Testing

Whether auditing against QMS standards or targeted quality tasks, our team of experienced auditors
provide on-site assessments across a variety of accreditation schemes including environmental
testing.

Test Method Development

We are the packaging industry experts on testing methodologies, protocols, and training. Let us
design, refine, and/or document a specific method to meet your requirements.

Document Management

Our software acts as a centralized repository for your product specifications, supplier
certifications, and regulatory documents, serving to reduce the time and effort required to keep
them organized and secure.

Consulting

Our experienced packaging experts help clients across a variety of industries achieve the highest
level of packaging quality. Whether overall continuous improvement initiatives or targeted, unique
projects, we are here to help resolve your packaging challenges.

## Industries We Serve

Our team understands that packaging is an extension of the product it contains, and in many cases,
it is the first thing a consumer sees and associates with the brand, regardless of industry. Whether
that packaging is intended to keep food secure during takeout, to catch the eye of a new customer,
or to ensure the product survives the delivery lifecycle, our programs are designed to operate as an
extension of your packaging teams.
* #### Food Service
  
  Hot/Cold Cups & Lids, Clamshells, Wraps, Folding Cartons, Cutlery, Straws, Paper & Poly Bags,
  Pizza Boxes
* #### Consumer Packaged Goods
  
  Films & Wraps, Labels & Tape, Pouches, Rigid Containers, Blister Packs, Cans, Bottles, Caps &
  Closures
* #### E-Commerce
  
  Paper & Poly Mailers, Corrugate, Temperature Controlled Packaging (TCP)
* #### Retail
  
  Paper & Poly Bags, Protective & Delivery Packaging, Bulk Containers, Display & Stack Packaging,
  Flexible Packaging
* #### Manufacturers, Suppliers, & Converters

## pricing. By staying closely aligned with manufacturing operations, we maintain control over

## Our  Export Process

We ensure a seamless and transparent journey for every international shipment, from initial inquiry
to final delivery.

1

### Quotation Issued

You request a quote, and we send a customized quotation based on your product need.

3

### Free Sample Sent

After documentation, we ship a free sample (courier cost covered by buyer).

4

### Buyer Confirms & Pays Advance

You sign the FCO, place an order, and pay the advance to kick off production.

6

### Final Approval & Payment

You review photos/videos of the final goods and complete payment.

7

### Shipping Arranged

We load the goods and ship them. You receive all the required documents.

8

### Delivery & Quality Check

You receive and inspect the goods. If anything's off, we fix it fast.

2

### Official Documents Shared

You receive our Proforma Invoice and Full Corporate Offer (FCO).

### Production & Branding

We begin packaging and labeling, with your company branding if needed.

5

## Why Choose Us

## Built for International Buyers

We understand the demands of international procurement: compliance documentation, consistent
quality, timely shipments, and responsive communication. Our team of export specialists manages
every step from purchase order to port of destination.

- Dedicated export manager for every account

- Pre-shipment inspection & phytosanitary certificates

- Flexible payment terms: LC, TT, & DP

- Real-time shipment tracking & status updates

- Competitive pricing with volume discounts

## Quality Assurance

your specific requirements.

consistent quality standards. Each batch is checked for key parameters based on the product
category.
* Supplier verification
* Physical checks
* Category-specific quality benchmarks

## Controlled Processing & Manufacturing
* Specialised processing units
* Standardised manufacturing procedures
* Controlled production environment
* Consistent quality monitoring

Products are processed and manufactured in specialised facilities using category-specific production
methods and controlled procedures.

## Quality Assurance & Batch Verification
* Batch-wise quality checks
* Process validation
* Product consistency assessment
* Documentation & record maintenance

Each production batch is reviewed to ensure it meets predefined quality standards and customer
requirements.

## Export Packaging & Compliance

Products are packed according to international export requirements with complete traceability and
regulatory compliance.

## Our Business

## Providing Full Range of Contract Services

###### Bioavailability/ Bioequivalence Studies

We provide our BA/BE service according to Good Clinical Practice and we comply to ISO 17025/GLP.
Currently we have 350 completed and 250 ongoing studies in the field of analgesic, antiviral,
antidiabetic, antibiotic, immunosupressant, and many more. Our customers come from Indonesian and
International pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. Our reports have been accepted by FDA in
certain countries.

###### Clinical Trial

We offer in-house clinical trials with reputable investigators and we have collaborations with
various hospitals and universities in Indonesia, such as: RS Cipto Mangunkusumo, RSUD Dr. Soetomo,
RS Persahabatan, RS Medistra, University of Indonesia, Institut Teknologi Bandung, Universitas
Padjajaran, and many more.

We currently have 40 completed and 13 ongoing trials in the field of oncology, nutrition, neurology,
immunomodulator, hormone, and many more for both local and international customers.

###### Contract Analysis

We have provided 1400 completed and 150 ongoing contract analysis services in the field of chemical,
microbiological, biomolecular, physical/packaging testing, and many more for both local and
international customers

[HomeAbout.png]

## Why Choose Us
1. High commitment to quality and integrity
2. Customer-oriented service at competitive cost
3. Effective project management
4. Highly experienced and qualified staff comply to ICH-GCP guidelines
5. Updated and accredited laboratory
6. Full technical support for customers
7. Good networking with pharmaceutical industry
8. Collaborative network with other clinical research center

Pharma Metric Labs is certified with:
BE study report has been accepted by:
- BPOM (Indonesia FDA)
- BPFK (Malaysia FDA)
- BFAD (Philippines FDA)
- VDA (Vietnam FDA)
- CDDA (Sri Lanka FA)
- Nigeria FDA

team is passionate about exceeding customers’ expectations. We invest extensively in innovation and
training to deliver world-class flexographic platemaking and digital prepress services.

Polyflex is one of five worldwide beta test sites for major software and plate manufacturers. We are
ranked among the top flexographic platemakers and repro houses, and our work has been recognised in
the [Flexographic Technical Association of South Africa Print Excellence Awards][26].

*“Collaboration across the value chain, including brand owners, retailers, printers, converters, and

*We are a level 4 BBBEE and [SABS ISO 9001][27]-compliant company with a strong leadership programme

Η Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. δραστηριοποιείται:

Στον τομέα του Εξοπλισμού Εργαστηρίων Έρευνας και Ανάπτυξης, Ποιοτικού Ελέγχου, Βιοϊατρικής και

Στον τομέα της Ηλεκτρονικής και Ηλεκτροτεχνικής Βιομηχανίας, με εξοπλισμό για την ανάπτυξη της

## Παρέχουμε προϊόντα και υπηρεσίες υψηλής ποιότητας

που προσαρμόζονται στις ανάγκες των πελατών μας

Εγκαταστάσεις Εκπαιδεύσεις Εφαρμογές Δοκιμές & Διακριβώσεις Service

Ο πελάτης λαμβάνει συμβουλές για τις απαιτήσεις χώρου και περιβάλλοντος, ενώ επίσης εξετάζονται οι
προδιαγραφές για την ηλεκτρική παροχή και τις απαιτήσεις αερίων ή νερού πριν από την εγκατάσταση.

Οποιαδήποτε εγκατάσταση και λειτουργία συσκευής γίνεται σύμφωνα με τις οδηγίες του κατασκευαστή και
μπορεί να απαιτηθεί πλήρως τεκμηριωμένος έλεγχος IQ/OQ αν το επιθυμεί ο πελάτης.

[shutterstock_100411144__1_-removebg-preview][shutterstock_100411144__1_-removebg-preview]

Οι χρήστες του οργάνου εκπαιδεύονται πλήρως από εξειδικευμένο προσωπικό.

**Κάθε εκπαίδευση συνοδεύεται από ένα πιστοποιητικό εκπαίδευσης** στο όνομα του χρήστη,
υπογεγραμμένο από τον εκπαιδευτή.

[shutterstock_245572090-removebg-preview][shutterstock_245572090-removebg-preview]

Πέρα από τη βασική εκπαίδευση για τη χρήση του εξοπλισμού, ο πελάτης μπορεί να επιλέξει να λάβει μια
πλήρως δοκιμασμένη εφαρμογή που αναπτύσσεται από το Τμήμα Εφαρμογών μας.

Αυτή η υπηρεσία στοχεύει στην προσαρμογή στις ανάγκες του πελάτη και στη δημιουργία λειτουργικής
ημερήσιας διαδικασίας, περιλαμβάνοντας βελτιστοποίηση της προετοιμασίας δειγμάτων, ανάπτυξη μεθόδου
επεξεργασίας δειγμάτων, συλλογή δεδομένων, και επαλήθευση αποτελεσμάτων με εργαστήρια τρίτων.

## Σχετικά με Εμάς

Η ιστορία της Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. ξεκινά το 1955, όταν ο Νικόλαος Αστεριάδης ιδρύει την τότε
«ΝΙΚΟΛΑΟΣ ΑΣΤΕΡΙΑΔΗΣ» στη Θεσσαλονίκη – μια μικρή επιχείρηση με μεγάλο όραμα: να φέρει στην Ελλάδα
την τεχνολογική πρόοδο μέσα από την επιστημονική και βιομηχανική καινοτομία. Ένα όραμα που
εξελίχθηκε, επεκτάθηκε και σταθεροποιήθηκε το 1985 με τη σύσταση της σημερινής εταιρικής μορφής. 

Αρχικά δραστηριοποιούμενη ως αντιπρόσωπος εταιρειών επιστημονικών οργάνων της Αθήνας στη Βόρεια
Ελλάδα, η εταιρεία δεν άργησε να χαράξει τη δική της αυτόνομη πορεία. Σημαντικοί σταθμοί ήταν η
συνεργασία με την Eppendorf, καθώς και η αποκλειστική διάθεση των μικροσκοπίων ZEISS στη Βόρεια
Ελλάδα. Από τα μέσα της δεκαετίας του ’60, διευρύνει τις δραστηριότητές της στον τομέα του
επαγγελματικού ήχου και της εμπορίας ηλεκτρονικών εξαρτημάτων, ενώ το 1967 αποκτά παρουσία και στην
Αθήνα με νέο υποκατάστημα. 

Το 1973, η συνεργασία με τη JEOL καθιστά την εταιρεία πρωτοπόρο στον τομέα της Ηλεκτρονικής
Μικροσκοπίας, ενώ η στρατηγική συμμαχία με τη SHIMADZU το 1978 δίνει νέα ώθηση στην αγορά των
Αναλυτικών Οργάνων.

### CAA is the **Producer Responsibility Organization** for
### **paper and packaging** in the United States

As a nonprofit, producer-led organization, CAA is committed to delivering harmonized, best-in-class
compliance services to all producers to advance an efficient and effective circular economy.

[**California**][92]**
**Approved in January 2024 to implement the Plastic Pollution Prevention and Packaging Producer
Responsibility Act.

[**Colorado**][93]**
**Approved in May 2023 to implement the Producer Responsibility Program for Statewide Recycling Act

[**Minnesota**][94]
On Feb. 18, 2025, the Minnesota Pollution Control Agency confirmed CAA’s registration to implement
the state’s EPR program. Producers must be a member of a PRO that is registered with MPCA by July 1,
2025. 

[**Maryland**][95]
Selected in October 2023 to represent producer interests and serve as the single PRO on the State
Producer Responsibility Advisory Council.

[**Maine**][96]
CAA intends to respond to Maine’s RFP to serve as it’s Stewardship Organization (SO).

[**Oregon**][97]
CAA is the PRO in Oregon. On April 1, 2024. CAA was the only prospective PRO to submit a program
plan to DEQ.

[**Washington**][98]
On March 4, 2026, Washington Department of Ecology (Ecology) announced CAA as the PRO.

### CAA is the **Producer Responsibility Organization** for
### **paper and packaging** in the United States

As a nonprofit, producer-led organization, CAA is committed to delivering harmonized, best-in-class
compliance services to all producers to advance an efficient and effective circular economy.

[**California**][92]**
**Approved in January 2024 to implement the Plastic Pollution Prevention and Packaging Producer
Responsibility Act.

[**Colorado**][93]**
**Approved in May 2023 to implement the Producer Responsibility Program for Statewide Recycling Act

[**Minnesota**][94]
On Feb. 18, 2025, the Minnesota Pollution Control Agency confirmed CAA’s registration to implement
the state’s EPR program. Producers must be a member of a PRO that is registered with MPCA by July 1,
2025. 

[**Maryland**][95]
Selected in October 2023 to represent producer interests and serve as the single PRO on the State
Producer Responsibility Advisory Council.

[**Maine**][96]
CAA intends to respond to Maine’s RFP to serve as it’s Stewardship Organization (SO).

[**Oregon**][97]
CAA is the PRO in Oregon. On April 1, 2024. CAA was the only prospective PRO to submit a program
plan to DEQ.

[**Washington**][98]
On March 4, 2026, Washington Department of Ecology (Ecology) announced CAA as the PRO.

Testing Laboratory

## 100% Focused on Packaging

Through both routine and project-based assessments, our ISO 17025 accredited laboratory was built to
serve the needs of the global packaging industry.

[Learn How We Test][13]

Advanced Analytics

## Transform Your Data into Insights

We digitize your packaging testing data to automatically derive cost reduction and quality
improvement opportunities that will resonate at all levels within your organization.

[See The Power of Data][14]

## Who We Are

We are a Packaging Testing Laboratory with 12+ years of experience and commitment to excellence for
our clients and the packaging industry!

Our focus is on enhancing packaging solutions by collaborating with brands, packaging converters,
and raw material suppliers. Through these partnerships, we aim to improve product quality, reduce
costs, support sustainability efforts, and elevate the overall experience for end users.

We are equipped with both a Client Services Team and a Project Team to ensure your success.  We do
this by meeting with clients on a regular schedule, interpreting testing data, proposing corrective
actions, sharing industry best practices on test methods and sustainability initiatives, maintaining
specs on products, and providing facility audits and consulting as needed.

 


## Visualize Your Data

Interested in interacting with our ClearVUE data visualization platform? Click the link below to see
how we transform testing data into valuable insights, while uniting the packaging supply chain, one
test at a time.

[Interactive Demo][15]

## How We Help

Routine Product Testing

Ensure specification compliance, reduce waste, and proactively identify cost and quality improvement
opportunities through ongoing, scheduled assessments of both raw materials and finished products.

Project Based Testing

Whether it’s new product or supplier qualification, performance benchmarking, root cause analysis,
or competitive comparisons, our Projects Team will design a testing scheme for your exact
requirements.

In-Field Defect Audits

We quantify true in-field defect rates by collecting product samples directly from distribution
centers or retail locations, and then test each and every product in our laboratory to reveal the
true quality of what you’re buying.

Sustainability Analysis

Through a comprehensive set of testing, software, and consulting offerings, we can provide
sustainability measures, tools and services for every stage of a packaging product’s lifecycle.

Specification Development

By analyzing existing performance data, testing key attributes, and leveraging our established
industry relationships, we provide expert services to develop, update, or standardize packaging
specifications.

Facility Auditing & Environmental Testing

Whether auditing against QMS standards or targeted quality tasks, our team of experienced auditors
provide on-site assessments across a variety of accreditation schemes including environmental
testing.

Test Method Development

We are the packaging industry experts on testing methodologies, protocols, and training. Let us
design, refine, and/or document a specific method to meet your requirements.

Document Management

Our software acts as a centralized repository for your product specifications, supplier
certifications, and regulatory documents, serving to reduce the time and effort required to keep
them organized and secure.

Consulting

Our experienced packaging experts help clients across a variety of industries achieve the highest
level of packaging quality. Whether overall continuous improvement initiatives or targeted, unique
projects, we are here to help resolve your packaging challenges.

## Industries We Serve

Our team understands that packaging is an extension of the product it contains, and in many cases,
it is the first thing a consumer sees and associates with the brand, regardless of industry. Whether
that packaging is intended to keep food secure during takeout, to catch the eye of a new customer,
or to ensure the product survives the delivery lifecycle, our programs are designed to operate as an
extension of your packaging teams.
* #### Food Service
  
  Hot/Cold Cups & Lids, Clamshells, Wraps, Folding Cartons, Cutlery, Straws, Paper & Poly Bags,
  Pizza Boxes
* #### Consumer Packaged Goods
  
  Films & Wraps, Labels & Tape, Pouches, Rigid Containers, Blister Packs, Cans, Bottles, Caps &
  Closures
* #### E-Commerce
  
  Paper & Poly Mailers, Corrugate, Temperature Controlled Packaging (TCP)
* #### Retail
  
  Paper & Poly Bags, Protective & Delivery Packaging, Bulk Containers, Display & Stack Packaging,
  Flexible Packaging
* #### Manufacturers, Suppliers, & Converters

# Pharmaceutical & Medical Device Specialists

Launch and release your products with confidence, backed by GMP, GLP and ISO 17025 accredited labs
across the world.
[View Services][161]

## Decades of Expertise. Global Reach. Comprehensive Testing.

Cormica has a proud heritage spanning over six decades, partnering with pharmaceutical, medical
device, and combination product manufacturers to accelerate safe, compliant product development and
release.

## Our  Export Process

We ensure a seamless and transparent journey for every international shipment, from initial inquiry
to final delivery.

1

### Quotation Issued

You request a quote, and we send a customized quotation based on your product need.

3

### Free Sample Sent

After documentation, we ship a free sample (courier cost covered by buyer).

4

### Buyer Confirms & Pays Advance

You sign the FCO, place an order, and pay the advance to kick off production.

6

### Final Approval & Payment

You review photos/videos of the final goods and complete payment.

7

### Shipping Arranged

We load the goods and ship them. You receive all the required documents.

8

### Delivery & Quality Check

You receive and inspect the goods. If anything's off, we fix it fast.

2

### Official Documents Shared

You receive our Proforma Invoice and Full Corporate Offer (FCO).

### Production & Branding

We begin packaging and labeling, with your company branding if needed.

5

## Why Choose Us

## Built for International Buyers

We understand the demands of international procurement: compliance documentation, consistent
quality, timely shipments, and responsive communication. Our team of export specialists manages
every step from purchase order to port of destination.

- Dedicated export manager for every account

- Pre-shipment inspection & phytosanitary certificates

- Flexible payment terms: LC, TT, & DP

- Real-time shipment tracking & status updates

- Competitive pricing with volume discounts

## Quality Assurance

Our quality process is designed to ensure every export shipment meets international standards and
your specific requirements.

## Raw Material & Source Verification

We ensure all incoming materials are sourced from verified suppliers and production units with
consistent quality standards. Each batch is checked for key parameters based on the product
category.
* Supplier verification
* Physical checks
* Category-specific quality benchmarks

## Controlled Processing & Manufacturing

## Our Business

## Providing Full Range of Contract Services

###### Bioavailability/ Bioequivalence Studies

We provide our BA/BE service according to Good Clinical Practice and we comply to ISO 17025/GLP.
Currently we have 350 completed and 250 ongoing studies in the field of analgesic, antiviral,
antidiabetic, antibiotic, immunosupressant, and many more. Our customers come from Indonesian and
International pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. Our reports have been accepted by FDA in
certain countries.

###### Clinical Trial

We offer in-house clinical trials with reputable investigators and we have collaborations with
various hospitals and universities in Indonesia, such as: RS Cipto Mangunkusumo, RSUD Dr. Soetomo,
RS Persahabatan, RS Medistra, University of Indonesia, Institut Teknologi Bandung, Universitas
Padjajaran, and many more.

We currently have 40 completed and 13 ongoing trials in the field of oncology, nutrition, neurology,
immunomodulator, hormone, and many more for both local and international customers.

###### Contract Analysis

We have provided 1400 completed and 150 ongoing contract analysis services in the field of chemical,
microbiological, biomolecular, physical/packaging testing, and many more for both local and
international customers

[HomeAbout.png]

## Why Choose Us
1. High commitment to quality and integrity
2. Customer-oriented service at competitive cost
3. Effective project management
4. Highly experienced and qualified staff comply to ICH-GCP guidelines
5. Updated and accredited laboratory
6. Full technical support for customers
7. Good networking with pharmaceutical industry
8. Collaborative network with other clinical research center

Pharma Metric Labs is certified with:
BE study report has been accepted by:
- BPOM (Indonesia FDA)
- BPFK (Malaysia FDA)
- BFAD (Philippines FDA)
- VDA (Vietnam FDA)
- CDDA (Sri Lanka FA)
- Nigeria FDA

## Premedia Packaging Specialists

Polyflex manages branded graphics from concept to conclusion. As graphic packaging specialists, our
team is passionate about exceeding customers’ expectations. We invest extensively in innovation and
training to deliver world-class flexographic platemaking and digital prepress services.

Polyflex is one of five worldwide beta test sites for major software and plate manufacturers. We are
ranked among the top flexographic platemakers and repro houses, and our work has been recognised in
the [Flexographic Technical Association of South Africa Print Excellence Awards][26].

**Polyflex Group MD, Brett Pollock**

*“Collaboration across the value chain, including brand owners, retailers, printers, converters, and
industry suppliers, helps our team deliver a complete professional ‘print-to-pack’ solution. By
sharing knowledge, learning, and building consensus, we ensure successful outcomes for all.  *

*We are a level 4 BBBEE and [SABS ISO 9001][27]-compliant company with a strong leadership programme
that has driven rapid growth. We look forward to our continued collaboration with our customers as
we embrace the future.”*

## Graphics For Packaging

platemaking technologies to enable sustainable growth.

reduce stress, and meet brand expectations.

drive packaging innovation, ensuring our clients’ products lead in their markets.

## innovative graphic packaging solutions

Polyflex is Africa’s leading pre-media service provider for flexible, paper, label, and corrugated
packaging. Our commitment to innovation and training helps us provide world-class digital printing
for flexible graphic packaging solutions that exceed expectations.

We disrupt with bold ideas and swift actions. Innovation is in our DNA, driving us to find better
ways to make a lasting impact.

transparency, and always prioritise doing the right thing.

### Look for opportunity everyday

possibility.

Polyflex is committed to total Quality Assurance, complying with [SABS ISO 9001][37] and Am I Right
standards. Our goal is to ensure that our policies are understood, implemented, and continuously
improved, and that all products and services meet customer requirements and performance criteria.
